name: fables
description: Claude Fables: turns what the agent is doing into little animated cartoons above the prompt, written live by Sonnet or Haiku.

model.title: Scene model
model.description: The model that writes each cartoon scene: Sonnet, or Haiku for quicker, cheaper scenes. /fables model switches it in a session.

terminalRows.title: Terminal band rows
terminalRows.description: How many rows the cartoon takes above the prompt in a terminal; never more than the band has room for, less one.

chromiumPath.title: Chromium
chromiumPath.description: The Chromium (or Chrome) the terminal band draws its frames with: a command on PATH or an absolute path.

terminalGlyphs.title: Terminal band glyphs
terminalGlyphs.description: How the terminal band draws its cells: auto draws pixel art in half blocks and every painted look in 2x2 quadrant glyphs, twice the detail across; half or quadrant asks for one for every look (pixel art is always half blocks).
